title: Selective retroprocessing runbooks with cost-prediction and safety gating for console analytics
creator: Priya Nair
description: Provide a safe, operator-friendly pathway in Console to run targeted retroprocessing (selective reprocessing of historical usage events) with an automated preflight that samples data, predicts compute/cost, and attaches a runbook/approval workflow. This ticket implements backend coordinator logic, billing integration for cost estimates, and hooks for console runbooks so support and PMs can trigger scoped reprocesses without opening engineering incidents.
tasks: Design coordinator API: start/dry-run/status/cancel and per-tenant scope filters
Implement sampling dry-run that returns estimated row counts, projected bytes, and cost using current runtime profiles
Add idempotent watermarking and dedupe keys to reingest pipeline to guarantee safe replays
Build job shaper to respect tenant quotas and global budget throttles (rate, concurrency)
Expose streaming progress and divergence alerts to Console (percent complete, error-rate, estimated time)
Integrate with billing to convert compute estimate into currency for approvals
Create runbook templates and an approval endpoint (with audit log link)
Automated validation stage: sample-compare post-run metrics and generate drift report
acceptance_criteria: Console can kick off a dry-run that returns cost estimate within ±20% for moderate-size scopes
Coordinator enqueues and runs scoped retroprocessing jobs with checkpointed progress visible in Console
Reprocess pipeline produces idempotent outputs (replay markerempotency verified on test tenant)
Safety gating halts runs if error-rate or metric-drift exceed thresholds and notifies SRE/owner
Runbooks and approval flow record audit entries linked to the tenant and job ID
Estimated cost appears on the approval screen and blocks execution until acknowledged
